title: Council Verdict
description: An independent council's ruling on a flagged idea-contract. Teacher-produced (frontier, e.g. Claude Code / Codex running the council skill), consumed by Main when EMBEDDED in its review prompt. Never crew-authored, never read off disk by the sandboxed Main. Lives at state/tracks/<job-id>/council/verdict.json. NOT a pipeline artifact (deliberately absent from ARTIFACT_SCHEMA_MAP, so the validator's completeness check never expects it in a track).

risk_band.description: Fail-closed gate value: the MOST SEVERE band across valid seat votes.

risk_band_consensus.description: Advisory: the 2nd-most-severe band — resists a single seat spiking the risk. Not the gate value.

families.description: Per-family seat verdicts (two personas per family). Six votes are not six independent signals — this shows cross-family agreement, not a head count.
